dataCollected.heading: 2. Data we collect
dataCollected.personnelDetail: identity, contact, IBAN, date of birth, profile photo, daily wages, advances, deductions, attendance, and timesheet records.
dataCollected.adminDetail: name, email, project/site information, session security.
dataCollected.technicalDetail: HttpOnly session cookies, device type, error logs.

purposes.heading: 4. Processing purposes
purposes.body: Data is processed only for digital personnel tracking, transparent financial records, attendance, contract acceptance, and platform security. Data is not sold or used for advertising profiles.

security.heading: 5. Storage and security
security.body: Transmission over HTTPS; AES-256-GCM encryption for sensitive fields; role-based access. National ID numbers are not verified via NVI — only algorithmic format checks are applied.

thirdParties.heading: 6. Third parties
thirdParties.body: Vercel (hosting), Supabase (database), Brevo (email). They access only the data needed to provide the service.

devicePermissions.heading: 7. Device permissions
devicePermissions.body: The camera is used only for explicit user actions such as QR attendance, with device permission. No background covert recording occurs. Details are in the "Device Permissions" section of personnel contracts.

rights.heading: 8. Your rights
rights.bodyPrefix: For rights under applicable privacy law, contact the administrator who created your record or email
